title: Technical Support Intern (Product Engineering)
description: Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively. We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented intern to join our R&D team and support our Development and QA teams. You will keep devices, firmware and test environments ready, so QA engineers can focus on core testing and validation and we can deliver high-quality products. What you will do Support Development and QA teams with hearing aid fitting, device setup, firmware upgrades and downgrades, and build installation Prepare test environments and assist with build deployment and configuration management so teams are ready for development and testing activities Reproduce reported defects and change requests (CRs), collecting logs and information to support developers and testers in troubleshooting Manage and maintain test devices, firmware versions, user accounts and engineering tools Track support requests, work items and documentation using Azure DevOps and other internal tools, and keep documentation and reports up to date Learn internal tools, processes and product workflows while contributing to automation and continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort. What you bring A university degree in engineering and 0-1 years of experience in software testing, technical support or a similar field Experience with unit and integration tests, and familiarity with Agile methodologies and source control systems Good debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, supported by an analytical mindset and attention to detail Comfort in learning new tools and technologies and in coordinating with cross-functional teams A self-motivated and proactive approach, with the ability to work independently, drive topics forward and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team Good communication skills in English, including the ability to explain complex technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences. Who we are At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services. Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world. With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes. Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you. WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.
company_description:
WS Audiology is a global leader in hearing healthcare. We help millions of people with hearing loss regain the joy of hearing. We believe that hearing unlocks human potential - and that sound isn’t just something you hear - it’s something you feel, share, and live through - something truly wonderful. 

That’s why we design and manufacture innovative hearing aids that deliver wonderful sound for all.
